headline: Gunman opens fire in Kraków's Main Market Square'
dek: [VERIFIED FACT] A gunman drove a car onto Kraków's Main Market Square (Rynek Główny) at about 15:00 local time on Saturday Nov 7 and opened fire at random people from the moving car. Six people were killed (four women, two men) and 15 wounded, including two police officers -- one shot three times…
sources: Kraków police / Polish Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński / PM Donald Tusk via AFP (Straits Times wire carry); BBC news video Nov 7; Indian Express; People.com (Małopolska provincial office)
fault_line: Terror attack or lone gunman? Police have named no motive -- and three bodies at the shooter's home suggest the rampage began before the square. Was this an attack on Poland, or a family killing that spilled into a crowd
